import math
import sys

def readint():
    return int(sys.stdin.read())

def readLL():
    return int(sys.stdin.read())

PI = math.acos(-1)
EPS = 1e-6
INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

def qmod(a, b, c):
    ret = 1
    a %= c
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            ret = (ret * a) % c
        a = (a * a) % c
        b >>= 1
    return ret

def CNumberInit(MAXNUM, mod):
    inv = [1] * (MAXNUM + 1)
    p = [1] * (MAXNUM + 1)
    for i in range(2, MAXNUM + 1):
        inv[i] = (mod - mod // i) * inv[mod % i] % mod
        p[i] = p[i - 1] * i % mod
    for i in range(2, MAXNUM + 1):
        inv[i] = inv[i - 1] * inv[i] % mod
    return inv, p

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    k = int(input_data[1])
    mod = int(input_data[2])
    inv, p = CNumberInit(n + 5, mod)

    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(qmod(k, n, mod))
    else:
        megumi = []
        for i in range(2, n + 1, 2):
            if (i & n) == i:
                megumi.append(i)
        ans = 0
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(20)]
        dp[0][n] = 1
        min_k = min(17, k)
        for i in range(1, min_k + 1):
            tmpans = 0
            for j in range(len(megumi)):
                if dp[i - 1][megumi[j]] == 0:
                    continue
                Megumi = megumi[j] & (megumi[j] - 1)
                step = Megumi ^ megumi[j]
                k_value = step
                while k_value <= Megumi:
                    if (k_value & Megumi) == k_value:
                        dp[i][k_value] += (dp[i - 1][megumi[j]] * p[megumi[j]] % mod) * inv[k_value] % mod * inv[megumi[j] - k_value] % mod
                        dp[i][k_value] %= mod
                    k_value += step
                tmpans = (tmpans + dp[i - 1][megumi[j]]) % mod
            ans += tmpans * pow(mod - 1, k - i, mod)  # Using modular inverse of k-i
            ans %= mod
        ans = p[k] * (qmod(k, n, mod) - ans) % mod
        print(ans % mod)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
